svg.title: Mert Ali ERENTÜRK - Data & AI Engineer
svg.desc: Data pipelines, lakehouse design and LLM applications. A downward scan reveals the pixel portrait while the name, role, description and handle are typed letter by letter in parallel. The portrait rotates continuously through front, side and back views, including during both scans and the faint silhouette interval. Reduced motion keeps the initial portrait and all text visible.
